findings.summary: Work-proof command and checkout outcomes were not enforced.
findings.failure_scenario: A candidate-bound marker records a failed or unclean run.
findings.impact: Failed work could be promoted as passing.
findings.minimum_fix: Require complete passing Vetryn or Factory marker outcomes.

findings.summary: Equivalent raw lifecycle payload aliases were not rejected.
findings.failure_scenario: A lifecycle artifact uses raw completion or log aliases.
findings.impact: Sensitive payload data could enter canonical evidence.
findings.minimum_fix: Normalize and reject raw, completion, log, payload, message, and content fields.

findings.summary: Factory checkpoint identity was omitted from candidate binding.
findings.failure_scenario: A marker keeps the expected commit but cites another checkpoint.
findings.impact: Conflicting candidate provenance could be promoted.
findings.minimum_fix: Include retry checkpoint identity in the exact candidate set.

findings.summary: Canonical waivable acceptance dispositions were rejected.
findings.failure_scenario: A waivable criterion uses a reviewed deferred or not-applicable disposition.
findings.impact: The promotion gate could reject a plan-valid transition.
findings.minimum_fix: Validate waivability and matching ledger and progress semantics.

findings.summary: Review-authentication validators were absent from the protected inventory.
findings.failure_scenario: A lower-risk task directly changes an authorization validator.
findings.impact: Review authentication could weaken without high-risk handling.

residual_risks: The repo-local installed Factory bootstrap remains unavailable on this historical branch base.

state_impact: Only M0-14 canonical acceptance is rebound after review.
source_of_truth_changes: Promotion markers, candidate checkpoints, waiver semantics, redaction, and auth-validator risk classification now fail closed.
feedback_plan: Protected CI validates the final DeliveryHead.
blast_radius: Task planning and promotion evidence only; no product packages.
rollback_or_deletion_test: Focused regressions fail if any of the five closures is removed.
systems_questions.system_model_summary: The terminal batch closes exact marker, evidence, waiver, and review-authentication boundaries without adding a framework.
